# Cressy Lindsay & Honora Hollis

- [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) — Friend of — [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md) — college friends and companions · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Lady P70](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0070), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Place P52](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0052), +1 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> After enrolling at [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) visit [Old St](../codex/places.md#old-st). John's Cemetery to escape their feelings of insignificance. While exploring the historic tombstones, they encounter [Cressida Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), another lonely student, and quickly form a warm friendship with her.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P11](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0011), [v3 ch.Lady P19](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0019), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) chat with [Cressida Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) in the cemetery about her origin, indecisiveness, potential suitors, and reasons for attending [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). After inspecting a historic midshipman's grave, they bid [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) farewell and discuss their positive impressions of her on their way home.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036), [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v3 ch.Lady P62](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0062), [v3 ch.Lady P69](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0069)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) settle into college life at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), aided by Cressida Lindsay's social influence while [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) earns respect as Freshman Class president. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a stack of letters from home containing updates from [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and news from her friends and family, including humorous local stories from Mrs. Sowerby.
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007), [v3 ch.Home P10](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0010)_

> [Cressida Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) joins [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), Hugh, and Wilfred on a walk through the park and along [Linden Avenue](../codex/places.md#linden-avenue). During their walk, Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) share a quiet conversation about life and grief before the group stops to admire a quaint, historic cottage called Tabby's Place.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P8](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0008), [v3 ch.Park P14](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0014), [v3 ch.Park P21](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0021), [v3 ch.Park P32](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0032)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) visit Tabby's Place and successfully arrange to rent the cottage from Miss Tabby Linden and her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md) for the upcoming school year. Later that night, [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) visits their room and enthusiastically begs to join them as a housemate, to which [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) agree pending Mabel's consent.
>
> — v3 · Chapter X Tabby’s Place

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P0](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0000), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P38](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0038), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059)_

> [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) informs [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) of the visiting rules for Tabby's Place, which [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) happily accepts. After [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) departs, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) discuss how adding [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) to their group will help financially and express optimism about living together.
>
> — v3 · Chapter X Tabby’s Place

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P56](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0056), [v3 ch.Place P61](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0061), [v3 ch.Place P64](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0064), [v3 ch.Place P65](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0065)_

> At dusk in Tabby's Place, [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) admires the cozy living room where everyone has gathered. Over the past three weeks, the girls and [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) have settled comfortably into their new home after setting up their household furnishings.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) claims [Smudge](../character/smudge.md) as her cat after Cressy's attempt to kill him fails. [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) arrives with her two cats, [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), and reassures the girls that she will not strictly supervise them. After initial skirmishes among the cats, [Smudge](../character/smudge.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) eventually become close companions.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)_

> [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) writes a letter to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) describing her stay at Cousin Emily's boardinghouse in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point). She recounts her health scares, introduces the eccentric older boarders, and shares her growing admiration and feelings for [Ezra](../character/ezra.md) [Hale](../character/ezra.md), an earnest young theology student.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIV Enter Ezra

_Sources: [v3 ch.Ezra P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Ezra P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002), [v3 ch.Ezra P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Ezra P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

> At Tabby's Place, the young women prepare for upcoming examinations while discussing their future plans and cooking skills. Later, during an evening walk in the park, [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) reveals to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that [Ezra](../character/ezra.md) has proposed to her and she has accepted, reflecting on her past suitors and her devotion to him. Their conversation turns to Nell's own feelings toward [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md) and [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVII Mutual Confidences

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P1](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0001), [v3 ch.Confidences P14](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0014), [v3 ch.Confidences P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 ch.Confidences P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

> The girls return to Tabby's Place for their final year at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), sharing stories, teasing [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) about her past suitors, and settling back into their routine. Later, on a rainy night, [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) combat their study fatigue by reviewing old, dramatic [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) tales. Re-reading an old piece she wrote at [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) feels inspired to take a new step.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXV The Last Wexcombe Year Opens

_Sources: [v3 ch.Opens P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000), [v3 ch.Opens P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 ch.Opens P30](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0030), [v3 ch.Opens P44](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0044)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives news that her short story was accepted by a magazine, which she celebrates with her housemates at Tabby's Place. Later, during a walk, [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md) tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that his family will visit her, though they unexpectedly arrive a day early on Friday. The visit is full of awkward moments, including cats jumping on Mrs. Lisle and Aline accidentally sitting on Honora's hidden chocolate cake, though Cyril's sister [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) connects warmly with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P30](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0030)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her friends reflect on their college experiences before taking their final exams and attending [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chooses to wear Hugh's flowers and his gift over Cyril's, but after hearing a rumor about Hugh's engagement to [Rowena Calder](../character/rowena-calder.md), she angrily breaks the gift and refuses to dance with him at the graduation ball.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

_Sources: [v3 ch.B.A.’s P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P35](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0035), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P38](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0038)_
